name: 98121 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98121 (Seattle) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98121 (Seattle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
